posts.name: pwatson1974
posts.cooked:
In the light of the latest announcement concerning the delay to GSF to add yet more awesome to it, some people who combined both may now want them separated. As I appear to have far more money than sense, I'm offering to pay for the shipping of 5 non-American people who wish to uncombine their orders. Let me know, either in a PM or this thread, the name you used on the Kickstarter before 9pm GMT Sunday and I'll cover the shipping cost.

Those who accepted an earlier offer to pay for Vengeance shipping are not included in that 5. If you PM me before the deadline, you're covered anyway.
